name: Ho Quoc Pagoda
kicker: Trúc Lâm pagoda facing the sea
summary: Sea-facing pagoda in Dương Tơ: walk the triple gate and the courtyard, about 25 km from Dương Đông. It was inaugurated in 2012, on 14 December 2012, in ấp Suối Lớn. getThere: About 25 km from Dương Đông, in ấp Suối Lớn
heroCaption: The yellow triple gate at Chùa Hộ Quốc, with the stair and the hill behind
body: Walk the triple gate, the courtyard, and the halls that face the sea. Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Hộ Quốc stands in ấp Suối Lớn, xã Dương Tơ. The coastal road has the sea on one side and a limestone hill on the other. The spiritual project covers over 110 ha, and also 110 ha, with the temple itself at about 13.2 ha and the rest forest. The buildings follow Lý and Trần form. The temple was inaugurated in 2012, on 14 December 2012. The main works are the main hall, the ancestor house, and the triple gate, with lim-wood columns.

The temple is about 25 km from thị trấn Dương Đông. The gate takes no ticket, and parking is a donation. A free vegetarian lunch runs from 11:00 to 17:00 beside the main hall. Read the board at the gate for the day’s hours. The white figure and the gold roofs in the courtyard are the frame you came for.

gettingThere: Chùa Hộ Quốc is about 25 km from thị trấn Dương Đông, in ấp Suối Lớn, xã Dương Tơ. The last stretch is a coastal road, sea on one side and a limestone hill on the other. Go by motorbike or car and leave the bike at the gate.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: About 25 km to ấp Suối Lớn in Dương Tơ. The coastal road leads into the temple.

legs.heading: From the south road
legs.body: Dương Tơ sits on the way between the airport and the south. Pair the temple with Bãi Sao or the cable car on a south morning.

admissionNote: The gate takes no entry ticket. Parking is a donation. A vegetarian lunch is free from 11:00 to 17:00 beside the main hall. Read the board at the gate for the day’s hours.
